# Saudi Ease (سعودي إيز)

> Saudi Ease is an IT and digital services company based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi
> Arabia, founded in 2018 by Ibrahim Sifat. It builds websites and mobile apps, designs company
> profiles and brand identities, and sets up ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing software for businesses,
> mainly contracting, construction and industrial supply companies. On-site work: Al Khobar and
> Dammam. Other cities in Saudi Arabia: remote only. Languages: Arabic, English, Bangla.

Saudi Ease (www.saudiease.com) is not affiliated with "SaudiEase Holdings" (saudiease.it).
Gulf Orbit Contracting is a sister company with the same founder; Saudi Ease built its Gulf Orbit
employment management system (EMS).

## Facts
- Office: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia (no street address published)
- Founded: 2018
- Contact: +966 55 884 5503 (phone and WhatsApp) · info@saudiease.com · https://www.saudiease.com/contact
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 09:00–18:00, Friday 09:00–13:00, Saturday closed
- ZATCA: Saudi Ease sets up and integrates third-party e-invoicing software that meets ZATCA
  Phase 1 and Phase 2 requirements. It is not a ZATCA-listed e-invoicing solution provider.
- Prices: not published; quotes on request.
- Does not offer: Aramco or SABIC vendor registration, Excel/data-entry work, CV or document
  preparation, recruitment or jobs, digital marketing, standalone UI/UX or API projects, on-site
  work outside Al Khobar and Dammam.

## Services
- [Website design and development](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/website-design-development): company websites, custom CMS and e-commerce sites, Arabic and English
- [Mobile app development](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps
- [ZATCA e-invoicing setup](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/zatca-e-invoicing): setup and integration of compliant e-invoicing software (Phase 1 and Phase 2)
- [Company profile and branding](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/company-profile-branding): company profiles for pre-qualification and tenders
- [Logo and brand identity](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/brand-identity): logos, brand guidelines, printed brand materials
- [IT support retainer](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/it-support-retainer)
- [Professional email setup](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/professional-email-setup)
- [Google Business Profile setup](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/google-business-profile)
- [Business setup consultation](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/business-setup-consultation)

## Locations (on-site)
- [Web design in Al Khobar](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/website-design-development/al-khobar): our office; meetings at our office or yours
- [Web design in Dammam](https://www.saudiease.com/en/services/website-design-development/dammam): we visit your office in Dammam (no office in Dammam)

## Industries
- [Contracting & construction](https://www.saudiease.com/en/industries/contracting-construction): websites, company profiles and ZATCA e-invoicing setup for contractors. Our work includes the websites of Cobalt Core Contracting, Solidcore International and Al Bishri Company.
